This Payment Policy outlines the payment terms and conditions for purchases made on Buyavdeals.online (“Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). By placing an order on our website https://buyavdeals.online, you agree to the terms described in this policy.

Buyavdeals.online operates as an independent reseller of antivirus software, digital licenses, and computer/peripheral devices within the United States.

Buyavsdeals is owned and operated by AllRoundFix LLC, a company committed to delivering reliable products, transparent pricing, and a secure online shopping experience.

Accepted Payment Methods

We accept the following payment methods, subject to availability:

  • Credit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover)
  • Debit Cards
  • Online payment gateways
  • Other payment options as displayed at checkout

All payments must be completed in full before an order is processed or delivered.

Payment Currency

All transactions on Buyavdeals.online are processed in U.S. Dollars (USD) unless otherwise stated at the time of checkout.

Order Confirmation & Authorization

Once payment is successfully processed:

  • You will receive an order confirmation via email.
  • Digital products (such as antivirus licenses) may be delivered electronically.
  • Physical products (such as peripherals) will be processed for shipment.

We reserve the right to cancel or place orders on hold if payment authorization fails or if suspicious activity is detected.

Pricing & Taxes

  • Product prices are listed on the Website and may change without prior notice.
  • Applicable sales taxes may be added based on your billing or shipping address, as required by U.S. law.
  • You are responsible for ensuring that billing details provided are accurate and complete.

Failed or Declined Payments

If a payment is declined or fails:

  • The order will not be processed.
  • We are not responsible for delays caused by payment issues.
  • You may attempt payment again using a different payment method.

Digital Products & Antivirus Licenses

  • Payments for digital antivirus products are processed immediately.
  • License keys or activation instructions are delivered electronically.
  • Once delivered, digital products may not be eligible for refunds unless otherwise stated in our Refund Policy.

Fraud Prevention

To protect our customers and business:

  • We may verify payment information before processing orders.
  • Orders suspected of fraud or unauthorized use may be canceled without notice.
  • Additional verification may be requested in certain cases.

Refunds & Chargebacks

  • Refunds, if applicable, are handled according to our Refund and Returns Policy.
  • Unauthorized chargebacks may result in account suspension or order cancellation.
  • We encourage customers to contact us before initiating a chargeback to resolve any concerns.

Third-Party Payment Providers

Payments may be processed through third-party payment gateways. We do not store full payment card details on our servers. Payment providers handle your information in accordance with their own privacy and security policies.

Changes to This Payment Policy

We may update this Payment Policy from time to time to reflect changes in payment methods, legal requirements, or business practices. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised “Last Updated” date.

Contact Information

For questions regarding payments, billing, or transactions, please contact us:
